propositions: _repair_ticket calls rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log directly, bypassing rebuild_with_restore, so deleted SNAPSHOT sources are never restored during per-ticket repair
rebuild_with_restore is the documented single entrypoint for repair but only one call site (repair_or_plan) uses it; the other repair path (_repair_ticket) diverges without documented intent
_repair_ticket must route through rebuild_with_restore while preserving its no_commit parameter to avoid breaking batch repair's deferred-commit behavior
rebuild_with_restore needs a keyword-only no_commit parameter defaulted to False so existing call sites (repair_or_plan) are unchanged
_repair_ticket's disp dict must surface a restored filenames list mirroring repair_or_plan's output
A ticket with a deleted SNAPSHOT source should be recovered when repair runs via _repair_ticket after the fix (currently fails closed, RED before change)
